Outcome_variable.evidence_source: [/page/6/Text/6] Females reported more support from romantic partners (M ¼ 4.54, SE ¼ 0.09) than males (M ¼ 4.19, SE ¼ 0.09). There were no effects of group or sex at T2. At T3, there was an interaction between group and sex, F(1, 99) ¼ 4.50, p < .05, as shown in Figure 1. There were no group differences in romantic support for males (controls: M ¼ 4.41; SE ¼ .14; diabetes: M ¼ 4.58; SE ¼ 0.09), but control females reported more romantic support (M ¼ 4.65; SE ¼ 0.08) than females with diabetes reported (M ¼ 4.28; SE ¼ 0.15). There were no effects of group or sex on romantic conflict at T1, T2, or T3.
